evidence.title: GDPNow gold adjustment
evidence.finding: Unadjusted GDPNow omitted investment-gold treatment before March 6; alternate adjusted model introduced then and became standard April 30. framework_lessons: Check accounting definitions before interpreting ratios.
assessment: The gold/GDPNow accounting distinction is strong and explicitly correct. The options example explains downside honestly, but its expiration base-rate claim is false. The eight-year gold comparison also changes winner when dividends are included. The five-year forward gold forecast remains open, and the MSTR put can only be scored as a conditional payoff without an execution record.
